sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1
cd /tmp && apt-get download python3-rdflib python3-pyparsing python3-isodate >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -p /tmp/rlib && for f in /tmp/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$f" /tmp/rlib; done
cd /app && PYTHONPATH=/tmp/rlib/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages python3 - <<'PY'
import rdflib
g=rdflib.Graph(); g.parse('/app/university_graph.ttl', format='turtle')
P="""PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>"""
print("professors:")
for r in g.query(P+"""SELECT ?n ?role WHERE {?p uni:hasName ?n; uni:role ?role . FILTER(STRSTARTS(?role,"Professor"))}"""):
    print(r)
print("subquery bigdepts:")
for r in g.query(P+"""SELECT ?bigDepartment (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?c) WHERE {
 ?student a uni:Person; uni:role "Student"; uni:isEnrolledIn ?bigCourse; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
 ?bigCourse uni:isTaughtIn ?bigDepartment .
 FILTER(?ed <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
 FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd . FILTER(?gd <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date) }
} GROUP BY ?bigDepartment HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) > 10)"""):
    print(r)
print("all counts:")
for r in g.query(P+"""SELECT ?bigDepartment (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?c) WHERE {
 ?student a uni:Person; uni:role "Student"; uni:isEnrolledIn ?bigCourse; uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?ed .
 ?bigCourse uni:isTaughtIn ?bigDepartment .
 FILTER(?ed <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
 FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gd . FILTER(?gd <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date) }
} GROUP BY ?bigDepartment"""):
    print(r)
PY
EOF
